name: voice-dungeon-crawler
description: Voice-controlled AI dungeon crawler: speak natural language, a parser/LLM turns it into structured commands, a deterministic engine runs them.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @dungeon/server" "npm run dev -w @dungeon/game-client"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
